data.case_title: Kinderzuschlag approved for Ida and Jonas (Dec 2026–May 2027)
data.explanation: The Familienkasse (family benefits office) has approved an additional child supplement (Kinderzuschlag) of €297 per month for each of your children, Ida and Jonas, for December 2026 through May 2027. You don't need to do anything for the payments to start; they should arrive automatically. You may also apply separately with your local municipality (Kommune) for education and participation benefits (Bildung und Teilhabe) that come with this decision. If you disagree with the amount or any part of this decision, you can file an objection (Widerspruch); the app shows until when you may do so. If you miss that window, the decision becomes final.

items.action: Decide whether to file an objection (Widerspruch) against this decision if you disagree with it.
items.consequence: If you miss the deadline, the decision becomes final (bestandskräftig) and can no longer be challenged.

data.summary: The Familienkasse Musterlahn approved a Kinderzuschlag (child supplement) of €297 per month for each of the children Ida and Jonas, for December 2026 through May 2027. The decision also enables a separate application for education and participation benefits (Bildung und Teilhabe) at the local municipality, and may be objected to (Widerspruch) within one month of notification.
data.tax_note: Kinderzuschlag is a non-taxable family benefit and generally does not need to be reported on an income tax return.
